shared_elements: paired circular or oval chest features
curved horizontal bands across lower torso
short vertical incised lines beneath the curved bands
linear markings on the head/upper body
justification: Both surfaces show the same highly specific iconographic scheme: a schematic human-like figure with a block head, paired circular chest marks, a central ring on the torso, and nested curved bands with short vertical strokes below. The main difference is that the head and upper-body incisions are much clearer and more numerous in B, while in A they are faint or less visible.
